spec_family.name: New Construction Interior Door Slab Paint
spec_family.description: Complete painting of interior door slabs (faces + edges) in new construction. Covers conditional primer coat, 2 finish coats, interstage sanding, and hardware handling. Separate from door frame/jamb (SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH) and door casing (SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT). Uses EA_SIDE as primary unit — each face is an independently paintable unit that may have different finish assignments. Fine Finish Doctrine governs all process and quality tier behavior.

includes: Door slab faces (both sides, independently assignable)
Door slab edges (hinge edge assigned to hinge side, latch edge to opening side)
Conditional primer coat (bare wood substrates, or user override for factory-primed)
2 finish coats standard (3 light coats for louvered doors)
Interstage sanding and inspection between coats
Hardware removal/reinstall (spray method) or masking (brush method)
Light sanding between coats per quality tier

excludes.route_to: Hardware handling within scope, track is not painted

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier applied to this spec. Door slabs are scrutinized surfaces — QT2 not applicable.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2 NOT APPLICABLE. Door slabs are scrutinized surfaces requiring minimum QT3 per Fine Finish Doctrine.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Spray is standard NC production. Brush for touch-up or occupied spaces.
Finish sheen per Fine Finish Doctrine sheen/QT rules
configuration_dimensions.notes: Sheen restrictions per FFD: QT3=satin or lower, QT4=any except gloss, QT5=any including gloss

configuration_dimensions.description: Door slab type. Controls complexity modifiers and special tasks.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Complexity modifiers: flush=1.0, panel_4=1.25, panel_6=1.35, french=2.0, bifold=0.7, louvered=2.5

configuration_dimensions.description: Door slab substrate condition. Controls conditional primer coat.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Factory primer is transit protection — field primer recommended for quality work.

paintable_items.name: Door slab side (face)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each door face is an independently paintable unit. A door with 2 sides in different colors generates 2 separate line items. Standard door = 2 sides.
paintable_items.notes: Primary paintable item. EA_SIDE is the atomic unit per Doors Doctrine.

paintable_items.name: Door slab edge
paintable_items.counting_rules: Bundled with face count — not separate. Hinge edge assigned to hinge side, latch edge to opening side.
paintable_items.notes: Edges always match the face they are assigned to.

paintable_items.name: French door glass pane
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of glass panes requiring masking. Typical: 10-lite = 10 panes, 15-lite = 15 panes.
paintable_items.notes: Used for glass masking task calculation. Conditional on door_type=french.

variants.notes: Standard spray production. QT3 = quick glance inspection, spot sand between coats.
Premium spray production. QT4 = systematic scan at 3 feet, full sand 220 between coats.
Superior spray production. QT5 = critical inspection at arm's length, thorough sand 320 between coats.
Standard brush production. Reduced floor protection vs spray.
Premium brush production. Roll and Tip methodology recommended for panels.
3 light spray coats instead of 2 standard. Reduces drip risk on louver slats per Doors Doctrine. Spray-only practical.
Glass masking adds 80-120% additional labor over flush baseline. Pane count tracked separately.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total count of paintable door slab sides in scope
Count of bifold door panel sides
Count of door units for hardware removal/reinstall calculation
Total glass pane count for french doors

protection_zones_required.notes: Drop cloths under door being painted. Brush method — localized protection.
Spray creates overspray in door swing arc area. Protect floor in swing path.
Wall surfaces around door opening need protection from spray overspray.
Hinges and latch hardware must be masked or removed before painting.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Door slab meets frame at reveal. Same or different finish — two-tone doors exist. When same finish, slab and frame can be sprayed together. When different, masking required at reveal line.
Edges always match the face they are assigned to. Hinge edge assigned to hinge side color, latch edge to opening side color.

valid_input_states.notes: NC door slabs are typically factory-primed. Bare wood slabs (substrate_condition=bare_wood) require conditional primer coat. Factory primer is transit protection — field primer recommended for quality work.

output_state.notes: Output state determined by sheen configuration. Semi-gloss is default for door slabs per Fine Finish Doctrine.

relationships.notes: Door system = slab + frame + casing. Often same color but two-tone doors exist.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC interior door slab paint. Key features: EA_SIDE as primary unit per Doors Doctrine, door type complexity modifiers (flush=1.0, panel_4=1.25, panel_6=1.35, french=2.0, bifold=0.7, louvered=2.5), QT2 EXCLUSION (doors are scrutinized surfaces requiring minimum QT3), hardware removal conditional on spray method, french door glass masking tracked by pane count, MDF edge sealing conditional task, louvered doors use 3 light coats instead of 2 standard.
